per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Search results for recycled parts shall be returned to the user within 15 seconds under normal operating conditions.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The search for recycled parts shall take no longer than 15 seconds. The search results shall be returned in under 15 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Search for the preferred repair facility shall return results within 8 seconds under normal operating conditions.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The search for the preferred repair facility shall take no longer than 8 seconds. The preferred repair facility is returned within 8 seconds'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall handle up to 1,500 concurrent users at peak load without violating availability or performance targets.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be able to handle up to 1500 simultaneous users. The system shall perform with 1500 users as a time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall provide at least 98% availability (uptime) measured on a monthly basis.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall achieve a 98% uptime. The product shall not fail more than 2% of the available online time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall protect against common web attacks (e.g., injection, broken authentication) and implement operational protections such as rate limiting, WAF rules, and DDoS mitigation.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall prevent malicious attacks including denial of service.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Access to sensitive customer data shall be controlled by role-based access controls (RBAC) so that not all users can view all data.
The application must integrate with corporate single sign-on and conform to corporate authentication and logging standards enforced by the architecture review board.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall adhere to the corporate Architecture guidelines'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The parts feed adapter shall validate incoming feed schema, normalize fields into the application's canonical format, and emit alerts when feed structure changes are detected.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall interface with the Choice Parts System. This provides the feed of recycled parts data.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system's caching strategy shall prioritize search responsiveness while ensuring availability-related fields (e.g., part availability) are refreshed more frequently (target: sub-minute freshness for most updates).
The system shall gracefully degrade when feed fields are missing, preserving core discoverability and surfacing errors to operators via alerts.
Usability: At least 95% of adjusters and collision estimators shall report that the product is easy to use in post-training/user-acceptance surveys.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be easy to use by Adjusters and Collision Estimators. 95% of Adjusters and Collision Estimators shall find the product easy to use.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Training/learnability: Users shall be up to speed after two days of onsite training; remote training is acceptable for some regions but baseline is two days onsite.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be easy to learn by Adjusters and Collision Estimators. The product shall be learned with two days onsite training'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall comply with corporate UI guidelines including accessibility rules to support assistive technologies (e.g., screen magnifiers).
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall comply with corporate User Interface Guidelines'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Operational monitoring and alerting shall be in place for feed health, cache synchronization failures, and suspicious traffic patterns, and logs shall be forwarded to the corporate logging pipeline.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall prevent malicious attacks including denial of service.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The architecture and design must follow the corporate architecture review board patterns; deviations require formal change control and may be rejected.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall adhere to the corporate Architecture guidelines'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall employ logging and access audit trails sufficient for compliance and operational troubleshooting, integrated with the corporate logging pipeline.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall adhere to the corporate Architecture guidelines'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must be resilient to upstream feed flakiness by avoiding behavioral patterns that would overload the Choice Parts service (e.g., exponential backoff, caching, and throttling), to prevent either stale data or overload.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall interface with the Choice Parts System. This provides the feed of recycled parts data.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Usability testing and measurement shall include surveys after training and task success rates during usability tests, with short questionnaires immediately after training and after a couple of weeks in production.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be easy to learn by Adjusters and Collision Estimators. The product shall be learned with two days onsite training'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall support both onsite and remote training delivery, with onsite two-day sessions as the baseline expectation.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be easy to learn by Adjusters and Collision Estimators. The product shall be learned with two days onsite training'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall detect and mitigate malicious traffic patterns and route suspicious traffic through protections to prevent service degradation.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall prevent malicious attacks including denial of service.'
